program: U.S. Census Bureau Business Trends and Outlook Survey

source_population.coverage: All U.S. employer businesses, single-location and multi-location, excluding farms, for data from September 11, 2023 onward.
source_population.sample: Approximately 1.2 million businesses split into six biweekly panels of approximately 200,000 businesses; each panel is asked to report once every 12 weeks for about one year.
source_population.detailed_sector_caveat: Multi-location businesses operating in more than one sector are assigned to an unclassified sector and excluded from detailed sector totals to avoid double counting.

current_post_change.series_status: canonical for post-change current business AI use
current_post_change.question_object: whether this business used AI in any of its business functions
current_post_change.estimator_denominator: nonresponse-adjusted weighted businesses responding to the question

expected_post_change.series_status: canonical for post-change expected business AI use
expected_post_change.question_object: whether the business expects to use AI in any of its business functions

legacy_pre_change.question_object: business AI use in producing goods or services
legacy_pre_change.series_end_reason: The Census Bureau broadened the wording to any business function and observed a level shift associated with the change.

wording_break.governance_rule: Never stitch the legacy producing-goods-or-services series to the post-change any-business-functions series as one continuous AI-use measure.

ai_supplement_2025_2026.panel_design: Responses from all six biweekly panels are pooled; nonresponse adjustment is performed for each panel and weights are adjusted for pooled estimation.
ai_supplement_2025_2026.estimator_denominator: adjusted-weight sum of all businesses responding to the question
ai_supplement_2025_2026.canonical_acquisition_path: official Census downloadable files; supplemental content is not currently available through the BTOS API

Q24_business_functions.construct: business-reported AI use by business function during the last six months
Q24_business_functions.response_structure: yes/no/do not know by 15 listed business functions

Q25_task_change_modes.construct: business-reported modes of AI-related task change during the last six months
response_categories: perform a task previously done by an employee
supplement or enhance a task performed by an employee
introduce a new task not previously done by an employee

Q26_replacement_intensity.construct: ordinal business report of the number of employee tasks instead performed by AI among businesses selecting replacement in Q25

construct_contract.B_core_current: business-reported current AI use under the post-November-2025 any-business-function wording
construct_contract.B_core_expected: business-reported expectation of AI use over the next six months
construct_contract.B_function: business-reported AI use within a named business function over the supplement reference window
construct_contract.B_task_change: business report of AI replacing, supplementing/enhancing, or introducing employee tasks
construct_contract.A_worker: worker-reported GenAI adoption for work in RPS
construct_contract.H_worker: worker-reported share of work hours actively using GenAI
prohibited_collapses: business AI use is not worker adoption
business-function use is not worker task adoption
business-reported task replacement or enhancement is not measured productivity
legacy and post-change BTOS core AI series are not one continuous series
sector-level BTOS/RPS association is not an organizational effect
BTOS and RPS measures must not be combined into a composite adoption score

cross_source_alignment.rps_comparison_role: triangulation across different units and denominators
cross_source_alignment.required_sector_crosswalk: Versioned 2022-NAICS-to-RPS-20-industry mapping with explicit ambiguity, coverage, and unclassified-sector treatment.
required_reporting: BTOS question wording and reference period

source_use.api_permitted_uses_summary: Census API terms permit services to search, display, analyze, retrieve, and view released Census data subject to confidentiality, attribution, representation, and access-limit conditions.
source_use.api_required_notice: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
source_use.supplement_asset_terms_status: Use remains subject to applicable Census website policies/notices and source citation; no respondent-level data are involved in this aggregate source gate.

completed_source_reproduction_requiremen: Pinned exact official National.xlsx and Sector.xlsx source bytes for cycle 202617 with retrieval timestamp, byte size, and SHA-256.
Recorded exact Question 7 / Answer 1 identity, cycle dates, estimate fields, and published standard errors.
Built and tested a versioned 2022-NAICS-to-RPS-20-industry crosswalk with exact Census source keys and explicit unclassified/unsupported treatment.
Reproduced the cycle-202617 national and sector Question 7 / Answer 1 source observations directly from the pinned workbooks.
Preserved Census suppression code S and published standard errors without reconstructing suppressed cells.
remaining_before_cross_source_analysis: Pre-specify the BTOS-versus-RPS comparison period and eligible comparability tiers before examining cross-source patterns.
Pre-specify treatment of BTOS-suppressed sectors, XX unclassified businesses, and RPS Public Administration with no BTOS counterpart.
Use only RPS observations authorized by the independent RPS source-rights gate.
Report BTOS business measures and RPS worker measures only as explicitly labeled triangulation; do not treat agreement or disagreement as causal evidence.
Do not combine BTOS and RPS measures into a composite adoption score.
